domain_summary_url: MADS-box transcription factor 16; Probable transcription factor involved in the development of floral organs. Required for normal development of lodicules and stamens (whorls 2 and 3). May function as a heterodimer with MADS4.
MADS-box transcription factor 2; Probable transcription factor involved in the development of floral organs. B-class protein required for normal development of lodicules (whorl 2).

MADS-box transcription factor 3; Probable transcription factor involved in the development of floral organs. Acts as C-class protein in association with MADS58. Involved in the control of lodicule number (whorl 2), stamen specification (whorl 3) and floral meristem determinacy (whorl 4), but not in the regulation of carpel morphogenesis. Plays a more predominant role in controlling lodicule development and in specifying stamen identity than MADS58.

MADS-box transcription factor 4; Probable transcription factor involved in the development of floral organs. B-class protein required for normal development of lodicules and stamens (whorls 2 and 3). May function as a heterodimer with MADS16.

MADS-box transcription factor 47; Transcription factor that modulates expressions of multiple genes involved in cell signaling and gene transcription. Plays a negative regulatory role in brassinosteroid signaling.
MADS-box transcription factor 7; Probable transcription factor. May be involved in the control of flowering time.
MADS-box transcription factor 8; Probable transcription factor. May be involved in the control of flowering time.
